decided: Each account step keeps in its skill only when to read its reference file — at the end of an apply session, and at the end of a review walk — and reads it every time; the reference decides whether to write the account. Nothing in orbit reports a change whose apply is complete and which has no account.
alternatives: read the reference only when the apply gate reads passed
read it when the gate reads passed or this session declares its remaining tasks as handoffs to the user
decide from the task list alone, in the skill's own text
why: The gate counts a task handed to the user only once a session's run summary has declared it, and that summary is written after the account step, so a gate-keyed read would miss a change that ends on its first such task; any condition that sees that case rides on every turn of every session, while one read at the step's moment costs only the session's last few turns.

defines.definition: the plain-language note a change carries of what it built, where the user is newly asked something, and where the work left its plan
orbit's check that a change's tasks are done; it reads passed when every task is checked, or only tasks handed to the user remain
a file beside a skill's body that the agent reads only when the body tells it to
the session that goes through a review's findings one by one and resolves each
